selection_rule: include a simple established baseline appropriate to the representation
select nearest mechanism from DNA/similarity map
select established competitive method with evidence in same regime
select recent method only if independently specifiable and regime-relevant
include specialist when the gap concerns noise constraints scale or other special regime
include decomposition-based comparator when geometry/decomposition is relevant
include reference-direction method when objective count is high
if proposing mechanism M compare parent vs parent+M
report objective evaluations and relevant optimizer overhead separately
